pending_interview.category: Case/product sense — client scoping walkthroughs, articulating tradeoffs out loud, build-vs-buy reasoning
pending_interview.question: A regional retail bank approaches you. They want to personalize the offers shown to customers in their mobile app — things like loan refinancing suggestions, savings account upgrades, and credit card offers. Their current setup shows the same offer to every customer. They have two years of transaction history, a CRM with basic demographic data, and a small data team of four people. A vendor is pitching them a turnkey AI personalization platform for $400K/year. You're the FDE helping them scope the decision. Walk me through how you'd evaluate whether to build, buy, or start somewhere else entirely — and what the first 90 days looks like under whichever path you'd recommend.
